sentences.en: The more contributors there are, the more useful Tatoeba will become!
sentences.zh: 贡献者越多，Tatoeba 就会变得越有用！

sentences.en: Contributors should add sentences that are respectful of others.
sentences.zh: 贡献者应该添加尊重他人的句子。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, most Lojban contributors indicate no country in their profiles.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，大多数 Lojban 贡献者在他们的个人资料中没有标明国家。

senses.zh: 捐款人;捐助人 - 促成因素 - 投稿者;撰稿者
